conclusion: The earlier browser-local-flag concern is resolved for an alternate or direct whole-graph invocation containing the same actual active node: current laneNode itself now has a shared consuming flag checked in its preflight. Every callback-emitting node in the inspected enrolled path likewise locks its own consume and checks that lock during preflight. Scheduler invokes ALL preflights before ANY consumes, so the nested whole graph rejects before any nested supplied callback. Browser's own flag need not span the whole invocation for that contract. This proves neither no reentry nor serialization of arbitrary independent operations.

Every predicate must be synchronous and complete before the next; each active flag is cleared in finally.

graph_shape: Candidate browser node depends on its exact registered lane node if nonempty and complete, and on exact actual legacy-tools node. The latter depends on its actual table-tools node; table-tools depends on its actual lane node when complete, its independently constructed frame node and actual repair/current-tool node. Any registered table/base context included by either lane contributes its exact actual guard node transitively; table context includes sourceNode and its actual tools. Dependencies may share a node only by actual object identity. Empty lane has no row callback; a nonempty opaque/mismatched lane does not enroll and is outside this proof.
qualification: The guarantee is for a nested WHOLE plan whose transitive dependencies contain the exact currently active node. An arbitrary manually called isolated node.consume bypasses scheduler preflights and is not covered. A direct invocation of the same composed guard is also covered by its own running flag or idle check. A truly independent factory has distinct nodes/flags and can execute independently subject to any actual lower node it shares.

This relies on preflight physical/identity/metadata functions being callback-free under trusted committed code; sourceBase metadataOk and inspector identity are local pure predicates, while physical readers do not delegate to supplied read. It does not cover hostile monkeypatching of builtins or concurrent writers beyond stated contracts.

A callback reached from a qualifier, comparisonReference or constructor outside an enrolled scheduler consume has its own independent guard contract and is not automatically covered by a particular active node; do not widen this proof to those operations. Final order and consumed-byte checks are separate correctness obligations.
